name: Kovos

facts.text: Kovos: NPC template 60162979, level 35, a drakoran model (as Lieutenant Zudd, Ra'ris Delum and Arel Birn), no faction, aggro 200 (range 500), no spells, respawn 80 s, in the middle of the isle at 461558, 473542 with drakoran looters, sawbones and a thaumaturge.

facts.text: Kovos as the drakoran's master of looters and his tally of books are Living Server writing.

story:
When the drakoran legion came over Avalon Isle after the burning, it did not come to stay at first; it came to pick the bones. The colleges' houses and farms and orchards were full of things the colleges had left, and the legion sent its looters through them, house by house, with sawbones behind them for the wounded and a thaumaturge to say what was worth carrying. Kovos runs that work, and runs it still.

He is not a captain like Bolin or Vask or Barak, and he does not watch the shores. He watches the carts. The looters bring him what they find, and he sorts it: metal to the smiths, cloth to the camps, food to whoever is hungriest, and books, always, to one side, in a pile that is never burned. Gwilym the cider-man of Wearyall says Kovos cannot read, and keeps the books because someone above him told him to, and that the books go down the stair into the drakoran's own Avalon once a season.

Elowen of Caer Gothwaite would give a great deal to know which books, and who reads them below.
legend: Kovos, level 35 drakoran, in the middle of Avalon Isle with a few drakoran looters, sawbones and a thaumaturge (31-33). No faction of his own, but the looters around him are aggressive and close, so you will fight two or three at once: kill the thaumaturge first. Plain melee, no spells. Respawn is fast (80 seconds). Good named for a group in the mid thirties.
